criteria.text: For interactive WS dispatch with a runEpisodeId bound to a declared system-prompt-v1 experiment, the exact reserved cohort's system prompt is sent to the SDK as the effective system override (unconditionally replacing the profile's own systemPrompt and any transient skill/memory preface), and an immutable treatment receipt is finalized with the enrollment transitioning reserved -> dispatched.
If the durable target drifts between reservation and WS dispatch, no prompt is sent through the WS path and the enrollment is marked treatment_failed with a target_drifted reason.

A redispatch/retry of the same runEpisodeId through the WS interactive path (e.g. WS reconnect, or an idempotent retry) reuses the existing reservation and receipt -- exactly one enrollment row and exactly one treatment receipt exist afterward, and no error occurs (no double-reservation, no conflicting second receipt).
A real baseline and a real candidate run through the actual WS interactive path for a declared system-prompt-v1 experiment receive distinct effective system prompts.
